# BuildZone Technology

> BuildZone Technology is a premier software engineering, artificial intelligence, and digital product studio. We architect and scale high-performance web platforms, cross-platform mobile apps, autonomous AI agents, and enterprise cloud solutions for startups and global leaders.

## Core Engineering Services

- [Web Application Development](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/web-development): Scalable, type-safe full-stack web platforms built with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- [Mobile App Development](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/mobile-app-development): High-performance native & cross-platform iOS and Android mobile solutions built with React Native and Flutter.
- [AI & Intelligent Automation](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/ai-development): Autonomous LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), custom machine learning models, and cognitive workflow automation.
- [Custom Enterprise Software](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/custom-software): Resilient microservices architectures, distributed systems, and domain-driven enterprise software.
- [SaaS Product Architecture](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with usage-based billing engines, multi-region database replication, and granular RBAC.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](https://buildzonetech.vercel.app/services/cloud-devops): Kubernetes cluster orchestration, Terraform infrastructure-as-code, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
